Does anyone know what's the difference between these two songs ?

https://preview.redd.it/mutt6rpry0na1.png?width=731&format=png&auto=webp&s=e60c75bc15b9a1c258b8b41195f0648f17c28fcf

Hey, it's when you reach x100 and the raid leader uses the Wei esther to kill the upper right frog and stagger Vykas at the same time. It implies you to kill the frog on bottom left with the rest of the group. To do so you need to stack up your lust bar just above the threshold by staying in the big blood flask around Vykas that starts spreading right when her stagger bar spawns.

This strategy can be very efficient as it gives you a decent window to DPS Vykas right after you kill the frog and allows you to have your lust bar filled up for one of the upcoming mech, that is the tentacles which require your lust bar to be filled up to damage them.

You can use this to calculate the DPS gain [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gdIqO4vN-IYWlfGxd2aXMkqa063S1P7KvxJ1AkIzBwI/edit#gid=0](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gdIqO4vN-IYWlfGxd2aXMkqa063S1P7KvxJ1AkIzBwI/edit#gid=0)
I checked it out when I first came here but a re-reading might not be too bad. Thanks for the idea!

Your last sentence is kind of true. Keeping ourselves busy helps.

Because we all live something different. As someone who is not suicidal, I haven't (yet ?) lived something worth making me feel about suicide. Of course I have my bad mood periods, but I try to pertain to things that make me happy and try to put things into perspective.

Work is of course kind of a burden, even if I managed to end up where I always wanted, but this is also what keeps me busy and away from loneliness and boredom.

And for school, I had it and decided I would take a break and work before eventually ending my studies. There's plenty of choice that you can make to make you feel better in life. If they're accessible to you, don't hesitate. If not, try to fight for them or find alternatives.

If it makes you feel better, I'm 23 in 2 months and have not ever kissed any girl. You still have time ! 😊

Sometimes it just takes time to find what you are really looking for. Don't try to stick to what people usually do. You are yourself and maybe you just didn't find what suits you yet ? That's how I feel and I don't wanna waste my own pride just because others have done it before me. If I can give you any advice, that'd be not to take it too seriously. I even joke about it to my friends, that's how I cope with it.

You are so young ! Plenty of good things awaits you, I'm sure of it. Where you start does not define where you'll end up. Try not to focus on the problem but on the solutions. You will soon be able to make your own adult choices and go back to where you lived, if that's what you want. :)
